simple.meaning: חׇפְשׁוּת (chophshûwth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “prostration by sickness.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Kings 15:5. The surrounding context includes family line, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חׇפְשׁוּת (H2669) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חׇפְשׁוּת (chophshûwth) / H2669 is traced through 2 Kings 15:5, 2 Chronicles 26:21 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Yahweh struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son was over the household, judging the people of the land.
